task_completion.description: Log into the GeoServer web interface using the provided credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The GeoServer admin dashboard is visible, showing 'Logged in as admin'.

task_completion.description: Create a new SLD style named 'population_choropleth' within the 'ne' workspace.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Styles' page shows a new style entry with the name 'population_choropleth' and workspace 'ne'.

task_completion.description: Configure five classification rules for the 'pop_est' attribute with specific hex colors.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SLD editor shows XML or a rule builder with 5 rules using filters for 'pop_est' and Fill parameters: #ffffb2, #fecc5c, #fd8d3c, #f03b20, and #bd0026.

task_completion.description: Add text labels for 'name' and gray borders to the style configuration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SLD code or editor shows a 'TextSymbolizer' for 'name' (SansSerif, size 10, halo) and a 'Stroke' color of #999999 with width 0.5.

task_completion.description: Assign 'population_choropleth' as the default style for the 'ne:ne_countries' layer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Layers' configuration page for 'ne_countries' shows 'population_choropleth' selected as the Default Style.

task_completion.description: Generate and export the final WMS map image to the specified output path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or terminal view confirms the existence of '/home/ga/output/population_map.png', or a Layer Preview shows the styled map.

integrity.description: The agent used the GeoServer web interface rather than just executing background scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the browser navigating through GeoServer's Workspace, Style, and Layer menus.

integrity.description: The agent actually input the SLD parameters (colors, filters, labels) into the GeoServer UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the SLD editor window with the specific hex codes and population thresholds typed or pasted in.

integrity.description: The final image is a result of GeoServer rendering, not a pre-existing file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Layer Preview' or 'OpenLayers' view in GeoServer shows the map with the expected choropleth colors before export.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The style must be named 'population_choropleth' in the 'ne' workspace. The five classification colors are #ffffb2 (<1M), #fecc5c (1M-10M), #fd8d3c (10M-100M), #f03b20 (100M-500M), and #bd0026 (>=500M). Borders must be #999999 (width 0.5). Labels must use the 'name' attribute, SansSerif font, size 10, color #333333, with a white (#ffffff) halo of radius 2. The output file must be exactly at /home/ga/output/population_map.png.
